## Checklist

- [ ] Branched off `main`, Conventional Commit messages.
- [ ] Tests cover non-trivial logic, and the suite passes locally.
- [ ] No secrets, and the lockfile is committed if dependencies changed.
- [ ] CI is green (typecheck, tests on both platforms, packaged build, secret scan).

## Note on external PRs

Stafford is primarily a personal project. I review pull requests and merge at my discretion, and external PRs
are not auto-merged. A green CI run means the tests passed, not that the change is accepted. Thanks for
understanding.
